title: Skill Browser QA HowTo
desc: T2 execution tier for skill-browser-qa. Step-by-step commands for static grep checks, build, localhost server startup, and each runtime browser test scenario.
steps: PARENT T1: wkappbot skill read skill-browser-qa
STATIC GREP COMMANDS (run from repo root D:/GitHub/wkappbot-sdk):\n  grep -c githubLogin docs/skills/index.html  # expect 0\n  grep -rn 'data-full' docs/skills/*/index.html
grep -v index.html  # expect 0 lines (detail pages only)\n  grep -l 'blurred' docs/skills/*/index.html

head -5  # spot-check premium pages exist\n  grep -n 'Part of:' docs/skills/a11y-command-cheatsheet-howto/index.html  # expect match\n  grep -n 'function unlockAll() {' docs/skills/a11y-command-cheatsheet-howto/index.html  # single brace
tail -1\n  Success pattern: 'Generated docs/skills/index.html with N skills and N detail pages'\n  Failure: non-zero exit -> check Python traceback for syntax/import errors

LOCALHOST SERVER STARTUP:
  python -m http.server 8888 --directory docs
  Verify: curl http://localhost:8888/skills/ returns HTTP 200
  Stop: kill the python process after QA (wkappbot taskkill /IM python.exe --dry-run first)

CDP-BASED BROWSER TEST (no manual browser needed):
  wkappbot cdp open http://localhost:8888/skills/  # opens in assigned Chrome
  wkappbot cdp open http://localhost:8888/skills/a11y-command-cheatsheet-howto/  # premium detail page
  wkappbot ask gpt 'describe what you see -- is there a lock icon, blur on steps, back link?'
RESET COOKIE STATE FOR TESTING:\n  wkappbot cdp eval "localStorage.removeItem('gh_token')" {proc:'chrome',cdp:PORT}\n  Reload page -> confirm blur/lock restored (no auto-unlock)

VALID PAT TEST:\n  wkappbot cdp eval "localStorage.setItem('gh_token','YOUR_PAT_HERE'); location.reload()" {proc:'chrome',cdp:PORT}\n  Confirm: blur removed, 'Pro access verified' shown, lock button hidden
CLEANUP: stop http.server process after all checks pass
